# MatGUI

`matgui.min.js` and `matgui.min.css` are the browser build of
[MatGUI](https://github.com/Matdata-eu/MatGUI) (`@matdata/yasgui` 6.6.0 on npm),
Matdata's fork of YASGUI. Font and image references in the stylesheet are
inlined as `data:` URIs so the viewer and its standalone HTML export work
offline.

MIT License. Copyright (c) Triply and Matdata contributors.

The bundle includes other packages, among them Leaflet (BSD-2-Clause),
DOMPurify (MPL-2.0 or Apache-2.0) and the Font Awesome Free font (SIL OFL 1.1).
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` at the repository root lists all of them with their
license texts.
